summary: SiteDocument is a data entity representing documents associated with a site in the HSPnet system.
purpose: To model and store site-related documents, linking them to specific SiteID values.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier of the site associated with the document

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page which displays a welcome view for staff administrators, including last login information, site and discipline filters, application viewing and filtering, and management of warnings and errors.
purpose: To facilitate staff administrators in viewing and managing employment applications submitted to sites, filtered by date, site, discipline, and application status.

actors.name: StaffAdmin
actors.role: Manages and views submitted employment applications

actors.name: System
actors.role: Displays filters, manages data binding, handles warnings and errors

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Page loads and initializes filter controls
User selects site and discipline (with dropdowns)
User sets start and end dates
User chooses whether to include withdrawn applications
User clicks refresh to view applications grid
System binds and displays employment applications matching filters
Application status and withdrawn date are displayed; name is linked

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are shown only if 'IncludeWithdrawn' is checked
Applications filtered according to selected site, discipline, date range
validations: Custom validation to ensure StartDate is not after EndDate
conditions: Show withdrawn applications when checkbox is checked
Show last login panel only if user has last login
system_behavior: Default button is set to refresh control
Error and warning panels can be hidden
exceptions: No data: Show 'No Data' label in grid
content_gaps: Actual business logic for filtering and actions is mainly UI and not backend; job is mostly interface and data binding.

summary: ServiceCode represents service codes, categorized and described, used for course and timetable options in HSPnet.
purpose: To provide a list and details of service codes that can be associated with courses, timetables, and other entities.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code

workflows.name: List All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll stored procedure with session ID
Iterate SQL results into ServiceCode entities
Localize fields based on session language setting

workflows.name: List Course Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID procedure with session ID and CourseID
Iterate SQL results into ServiceCode entities
Localize fields based on language setting

workflows.name: List Timetable Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session ID and TimetableID
Iterate results, localize entries

business_rules: When UseAltLanguageFields is true, display alt language fields for Name and Notes
conditions: Language mode (alt language) determines field values

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks actions and changes on site profiles, logging user actions, dates, fields, and agency/user information.
purpose: To maintain a historical record of changes made to site profiles, including who made the change, when, what section/fields, and the agency context.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the site profile affected

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of user making the change

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session
Iterate results
For each change, log action details

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and user ID does not match original, display support team message in formatted output
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted and AgencyUserDetailsFormatted provide display formats for user info
conditions: Alt language fields used if session requests

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents files used for email popups, with search and delete operations for managing email-related files.
purpose: To model popup email documents, provide searching and deletion functions for files stored in the system.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: If the popup document is checked/selected

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Split DataInfo string into email entries
For each entry, parse FileName and FilePath
Create EmailPopupDocument instance
Add to list

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Find document by ID in DataInfo
Delete file and directory (if possible)
Return updated DataInfo

conditions: If DataInfo is empty, return empty list or string
exceptions: Try/catch on file and directory deletion

summary: ExpenseBatch models batches of expenses for departments; supporting search, add, update, delete, and detailed view operations.
purpose: To track and manage batches of expense claims within departments, including batch number, status, dates, and associated department.

workflows.name: Search Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchSearch with department ID
Iterate results: for each, create ExpenseBatch entity with status and description
Format BatchNumber

workflows.name: Add Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchAdd with session, department ID, description, and date
Retrieve new ID

workflows.name: Update Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchUpdate with ID and updated fields
Execute database update

workflows.name: Delete Expense Batch
steps: Call ExpenseBatchDelete with session and ID
Database executes deletion

conditions: Alt language fields for StatusDescription when session requests
